title: Spire Legacy
description:
Every climb ends. Your bloodline grows.

Climb Slay the Spire as a family of heirs, with three classes, inherited traits and permanent manor upgrades, using content from your installed Rogue Legacy 2 copy.

120 cards per class (360 total), with distinct original illustrations and several Knight, Mage and Ranger deck strategies.

Requires Slay the Spire 1 on its regular branch, an installed Steam copy of Rogue Legacy 2, ModTheSpire and BaseMod. Enable BaseMod and Spire Legacy in Play with Mods. Local Rogue Legacy 2 content is prepared automatically on first launch; no game assets are included.

ModTheSpire: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1605060445
BaseMod: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1605833019

Creator: CapeKid. Original mod code and content: MIT. Windows x64 and native Linux x86_64 support; Steam Deck gameplay verified by the creator using Steam Linux Runtime and Proton. Source: https://github.com/CapeKid/SpireLegacy
changeNote: 0.3.0: add 45 cards to each class (135 new cards with individual illustrations). Each heir now has 120 cards, including 117 class-specific reward/shop cards. Expand armor, exhaust, blood, status, spell-sequencing, delayed-turn, retention, discard, poison, attack-chain and scry choices, with native reward generation preserved.
